findings.claim: The final candidate still requires TQ01/TX12/TX14.
findings.reason: The package itself leaves these GT-01 scoped gates open. The headed/runtime traces prove menu, movement, pause and quit, but no bound artifact proves the required root recreation/cache isolation and quota/network/auth/Stop semantics for this frozen package.
findings.verify: Provide scoped TQ01/TX12/TX14 reports with run IDs, host exits, postconditions and the same closure hash, then rebind the package.

findings.claim: Lifecycle recovery evidence is bound to the frozen source closure.
findings.reason: The lifecycle report records only four source file hashes and has no source_closure_sha256 matching 3ace23bcf84598cda64d54bbe3fc4736acde877f9f714fb71e2355d3e809eea4. Its own limits are synthetic offline packages, cooperative identity and candidate evidence, so the recovery result cannot be independently tied to the complete 25-file freeze.
findings.verify: Add a closure digest/reference to the lifecycle report and an independently hashed lifecycle artifact set, or have the package binder verify that relationship.

findings.claim: Archive/install recovery is represented by the final package.
findings.reason: The lock still says CANDIDATE and export templates ARCHIVE_VERIFIED_NOT_INSTALLED; lifecycle contains only synthetic 427-byte A/B archives. No official archive verifier output or reproducible install/rollback receipt is bound under the R21 package, while binder READY_FOR_CRITIC explicitly validates candidate facts only.
findings.verify: Include the official archive checksum/SHA512 and offline install/rollback receipts bound to this closure, retaining GT-10 full installer scope for its later gate.
